name: order_troponin
description: Orders a high-sensitivity cardiac troponin (hs-cTnI or hs-cTnT) test. Troponin is the gold standard biomarker for myocardial injury detection and is critical in acute coronary syndrome evaluation.

serial.description: Whether to order serial troponin draws (0h, 3h, 6h protocol)

when_to_use: Chest pain evaluation in emergency department
Elevated risk for acute coronary syndrome

examples.query: Draw serial troponins for chest pain

args.clinical_indication: acute chest pain with radiation to left arm
